verdict.rationale: Vercel documents automating domains through its REST API or SDK, adding custom domains with automatic SSL, and managing DNS records from the CLI in automated systems, so programmatic domain provisioning is a first-party capability. However, nothing in the evidence describes a multi-tenant SaaS workflow, such as attaching customer hostnames at scale or routing each tenant's domain to the right content. Middleware rewrites are only a building block and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented multi-tenant/customer-domain provisioning workflow, per-tenant hostname routing, wildcard or bulk-domain limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers
